摘  要 
图像作为信息传递的重要载体，不仅是人类感知与记录世界的基本方式，也
是众多计算机视觉任务的数据来源。然而，在图像采集过程中，常因相机设置不
当或场景条件受限而产生离焦模糊或运动模糊。前者通常由被摄体超出相机景深
引起，后者则源于相机抖动或物体运动。这两类模糊均会导致图像细节的显著丢
失，严重降低视觉质量，进而影响后续的图像分析与理解任务。尽管近年来图像
模糊处理技术取得了显著进展，但在应对复杂场景时仍面临诸多挑战：在弱纹理
与低对比度区域，模糊感知精度有限；对于空间变化显著的离焦模糊，高保真复
原仍具困难；在均匀退化场景中，先验构建与优化效率尚待提升；而在动态模糊
条件下，频率信息利用不足，限制了细节恢复能力。针对上述问题，本文引入一
系列有效的先验知识，用以引导离焦模糊图估计与图像去模糊，从而显著提升算
法在复杂场景下的去模糊性能。主要研究内容与创新贡献如下： 
1）针对弱纹理与低对比度区域中模糊感知不准确的问题，本文提出了一种
基于感知先验引导的离焦模糊图估计算法。该方法利用人类视觉系统在不同对比
度下对模糊感知的差异，构建感知权重以调制再模糊奇异值差异特征，从而增强
聚焦与离焦区域的可分性。同时，引入模糊-清晰边缘点作为额外约束，有效缓解
无边缘区域中模糊估计困难的问题。实验结果表明，本文提出的方法在定量和定
性评估上均优于现有方法，所生成的离焦模糊图可用于推导空间变化的模糊核，
为后续的离焦去模糊提供重要先验支持，显著提升图像复原效果。 
2）针对复杂离焦模糊场景下高保真复原困难的问题，本文提出了一种大模
型先验引导的离焦去模糊算法。该方法结合微调后的大规模深度估计模型与语义
识别模型，有效提取图像的结构与语义信息。随后，构建多模态融合模块，通过
交叉注意力机制引导预训练的扩散模型生成高质量复原图像。进一步地，利用深
度图先验生成离焦权重图，并结合加权拉普拉斯金字塔策略，自适应融合原图中
清晰区域与扩散模型生成的细化结果，从而提升结构一致性与细节保真度。实验
结果表明，本文提出的方法在离焦图像质量恢复方面显著优于现有方法。 
3）针对均匀退化建模中图像先验与优化方法设计不足的问题，本文提出了

一种基于动态极值先验的盲去模糊算法。该方法利用相机抖动导致的极值变化特
性，引入图像块最大/最小像素值作为先验特征，并结合模糊C 均值聚类算法，根
据像素特征动态划分先验类别。聚类过程在每次迭代中自适应更新，以匹配中间
潜在图像的特性。同时，设计稀疏诱导的优化策略以增强潜在图像的稀疏表达能
力，并提升求解效率。实验结果表明，本文提出的方法在自然图像和特定领域图
像上的去模糊质量和计算效率方面均优于现有方法。 
4）针对频率信息利用不足而导致细节恢复受限的问题，本文提出了一种基
于频率先验引导的扩散模型去模糊算法。该方法利用预训练的频率特征，并通过
交叉注意力机制将其分层注入扩散模型，有效恢复图像中的低频与高频分量。此
外，将模糊图像与频率先验联合作为条件信息，引导扩散模型更准确地建模复杂
的模糊分布，显著增强其在真实动态模糊场景中的适应能力。实验结果表明，本
文提出的方法在真实运动模糊图像中的细节还原能力明显优于现有先进方法。 
综上所述，本文围绕图像模糊处理中的问题，提出了一系列基于感知先验、
大模型先验、动态极值先验和频率先验的创新方法，系统解决了弱纹理感知、高
保真复原、均匀退化建模以及高频细节还原等难题，显著提升了离焦模糊图的估
计精度与图像复原质量，增强了模型在复杂场景中的泛化能力。

Abstract 
Images, as a crucial medium for information transmission, not only serve as a 
fundamental means for humans to perceive and record the world but also constitute 
essential data sources for numerous computer vision tasks. However, during image 
acquisition, defocus or motion blur often occurs due to improper camera settings or 
constrained scene conditions. The former is typically caused by subjects falling outside 
the camera’s depth of field, while the latter stems from camera shake or object 
movement. Both types of blur lead to significant loss of image details and textures, 
severely degrading visual quality and impairing the performance of subsequent image 
analysis and understanding tasks. Although image deblurring techniques have made 
remarkable progress in recent years, challenges remain in handling complex real-world 
scenarios. Specifically, blur estimation in weak-texture or low-contrast regions is often 
inaccurate; high-fidelity restoration of spatially varying defocus blur is difficult; prior 
construction and optimization in uniformly degraded scenes are inefficient; and 
insufficient utilization of frequency information limits the recovery of fine details. To 
address these challenges, this dissertation introduces a series of effective prior-guided 
mechanisms for defocus blur map estimation and image deblurring. These priors 
significantly enhance the performance of deblurring algorithms under complex and 
diverse conditions. The main contributions are summarized as follows:  
1) To address the challenge of inaccurate blur perception in low-texture and 
low-contrast regions, a perceptual-prior-guided defocus blur map estimation algorithm 
is proposed. Inspired by the human visual system’s sensitivity to blur under varying 
contrast conditions, perceptual weights are designed to modulate the re-blurred 
singular value difference features, enhancing the discriminability between focused and 
defocused regions. Furthermore, blur-sharp edge points are incorporated as additional 
constraints, effectively mitigating the difficulty of blur estimation in edge-less areas. 
Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing 
techniques in both quantitative metrics and qualitative visual quality. The resulting 
defocus blur maps can also be used to derive spatially-varying blur kernels, providing 
essential prior support for subsequent defocus deblurring and significantly improving

IV 
restoration quality. 
2) To address the challenge of high-fidelity restoration in complex defocus blur 
scenarios, a defocus deblurring algorithm guided by large-model priors is proposed. 
Structural and semantic features are extracted by fine-tuned large-scale depth 
estimation and semantic recognition models, and then integrated into a pre-trained 
diffusion model through a multimodal cross-attention module. A defocus weight map 
is generated based on the depth prior, and a weighted Laplacian pyramid strategy is 
employed to adaptively fuse clear regions from the underlying image with the 
diffusion model’s output, thereby enhancing structural consistency and preserving fine 
details. Experimental results demonstrate that the effectiveness of the proposed method 
is validated in restoring complex defocused images with high fidelity. 
3) To address the limitations in prior construction and optimization in uniformly 
degraded scenarios, a blind deblurring algorithm based on dynamic extremum priors is 
proposed. Extremum changes caused by camera shake are exploited, with the 
maximum and minimum pixel values of image patches used as prior features. A fuzzy 
C-means clustering algorithm is employed to dynamically classify prior categories 
based on pixel features, and the clustering process is adaptively updated in each 
iteration to match the characteristics of the intermediate latent image. Additionally, a 
sparsity-inducing strategy is designed to enhance the sparse representation of the latent 
image and improve computational efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that 
the proposed method outperforms existing techniques in both deblurring quality and 
efficiency across natural and domain-specific images. 
4) To address the insufficient utilization of frequency information that limits detail 
restoration, a frequency-prior-guided diffusion model is proposed for deblurring. 
Pre-trained frequency features are hierarchically injected into the diffusion model 
through a cross-attention mechanism, enabling effective recovery of both low- and 
high-frequency components of images. Moreover, the blurry image and frequency 
prior are jointly used as conditional information to guide the diffusion model in 
accurately modeling complex blur distributions, thereby significantly improving 
adaptability in real dynamic blur scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that the 
proposed method achieves superior detail restoration in real motion-blurred images 
compared to state-of-the-art methods.

V 
In conclusion, this dissertation proposes a series of innovative algorithms for image 
deblurring, guided by perceptual priors, large-model priors, dynamic extremum priors, 
and frequency priors respectively. These proposed algorithms systematically address 
challenges related to weak-texture blur perception, high-fidelity restoration, uniform 
degradation modeling, and high-frequency detail recovery. As a result, the proposed 
approaches significantly improve the accuracy of defocus blur estimation and the 
quality of image restoration, while enhancing the model's generalization ability in 
complex real-world scenarios. 
 
Keywords: Defocus blur map estimation; Image deblurring; Prior guidance; 
Diffusion model; Attention mechanism

摘要 
I 
摘要 
随着深空探测任务对空间分辨率与光谱信息获取能力要求的不断提升，研制高性
能光学成像系统已成为一项关键挑战。传统单孔径光学望远镜受限于镜面加工难度、
成本控制与系统实施，难以持续增大口径以提升分辨率。光学合成孔径技术应运而生，
该技术通过多个子孔径协同工作，可在不显著增加系统复杂度的情况下实现等效大口
径系统的分辨率。但是，光学合成孔径系统的成像性能仍受到多种因素的制约。首先，
光瞳结构影响系统的空间频率采样，需要设计合理的光瞳结构使得系统采样截止频率
以内没有响应零点，保证系统的成像质量并提升系统的空间分辨率。其次，子孔径间
存在相位误差会显著降低系统成像质量，因此精确估计并补偿初始相位是实现高质量
成像的核心环节。另外，光学合成孔径系统具有固有图像降质，而相位估计与补偿在
实际中难免出现误差，因此系统所成像存在降质，需要利用优秀的图像恢复方法进一
步改善系统的成像质量。另外值得关注的是，对于目标探测而言，尽可能多的获取目
标信息有助于目标特性的分析，而利用光学合成孔径系统获取目标的光谱信息，不仅
能够提升获取目标信息的维度，还能够拓展系统的功能。本文针对光瞳结构、相位误
差估计、光学合成孔径系统的图像复原以及利用光学合成孔径系统获取光谱信息这四
个关键问题，开展了详细的理论与实验研究，主要研究内容如下： 
（1）光瞳结构对光学合成孔径系统成像性能的影响分析与优化设计。系统分析
了填充因子对GOLAY3 结构点扩散函数、调制传递函数及成像质量的影响，确定系
统在保持成像质量前提下的最优填充因子为0.37，并进一步研究了子孔径遮拦比对系
统性能的影响，得出最大允许遮拦比为0.5。针对多阵元数目系统存在的点扩散函数
旁瓣高、调制传递函数中频响应不均匀等问题，提出一种基于费马螺旋的非周期、非
均匀子孔径排布结构。通过该结构降低了子孔径间的冗余配对数量，改善了中频响应
均匀性，为提升多阵元光学合成孔径系统的成像质量提供了有效的途径。 
（2）相位误差对光学合成孔径系统成像性能的影响分析与相位估计方法。详细
分析了活塞相差、倾斜相差和多阶像差对GOLAY3 系统的点扩散函数、调制传递函
数和成像质量的影响。利用相位差法作为相位估计方法，针对多阶相位估计过程中经
典随机并行梯度下降算法（Stochastic Parallel Gradient Descent, SPGD）无法收敛的问
题，采用自适应改变增益系数SPGD 算法，显著提升收敛稳定性；进一步引入动量机
制的AdamSPGD 算法有效加快收敛速度并降低估计残差。针对GOLAY3 结构全局相
位差法相位估计残差高的问题，提出斯特列尔比-相位差法（Strehl Ratio-Phase Diversity, 
SR-PD）分段优化相位估计方法，依次估计倾斜相差、活塞相差和高阶像差，并针对
活塞相差和倾斜相差估计设计了峰值斯特列尔比和桶中功率斯特列尔比两个新的评

价函数。采用所提出SR-PD 估计方法，活塞相差与倾斜相差的估计残差分别降至
0.0001 λ 和0.0129 λ，并将GOLAY3 结构的多阶相位整体估计残差减小到0.0651 λ。 
（3）面向光学合成孔径系统的数据集构建与图像恢复方法。详细分析了光学合
成孔径系统的图像降质诱因以及传统图像恢复算法的局限性。提出了根据系统光瞳结

5616 组图像样本，有效缓解了训练数据有限与真实场景失配问题。在此基础上，设计
了一种融合系统点扩散函数先验的图像复原网络（Prior Information Network, PIN），

PIN 网络使复原图像的峰值信噪比与结构相似度分别平均提升7.66 dB 与0.2667。进
一步引入Token 统计自注意力机制与有效通道注意力模块，构建增强型PIN
（Enhanced-PIN, E-PIN），加强对图像细节信息的恢复，并通过实验证明E-PIN 有效
提升了恢复图像的质量。E-PIN 恢复的图像，峰值信噪比平均提升8.72 dB，结构相似
度平均提升0.2835。 
（4）光学合成孔径系统获取光谱信息的理论和实验研究。根据傅里叶变换成像
光谱技术，建立了光学合成孔径系统获取目标光谱信息的数学和物理模型，并分析了
光谱获取的性能指标。在GOLAY3 结构基础上，给每个子孔径设置不同的相位延迟
率，构建子孔径之间差异化的相位扫描范围。在点源目标和扩展目标条件下，分别仿
真分析了系统对目标光谱信息获取的能力。开展了光谱信息获取验证实验，选取
GOLAY3 结构的其中两个子孔径，利用空间光调制器调节两子孔径间的相位误差，通
过采集的干涉图谱数据实现了对输入光的光谱信息获取，证明了光学合成孔径系统获
取目标光谱信息的可行性。 
 
关 键 词：光学合成孔径， 光瞳结构， 相位估计， 图像复原， 光谱信息获取。

III 
ABSTRACT 
With the increasing demands for spatial resolution and spectral information acquisition in 
deep space exploration missions, developing high-performance optical imaging systems has 
become a key challenge. Traditional single-aperture optical telescopes are limited by the 
difficulty of mirror fabrication, cost control, and system implementation, making it difficult 
to continuously increase the aperture to improve resolution. Optical synthetic aperture 
technology has emerged as a response to this challenge. This technology, through the 
coordinated operation of multiple subapertures, can achieve the resolution equivalent to a 
large-aperture system without significantly increasing system complexity. However, its 
imaging performance is constrained by factors such as the subaperture arrangement structure, 
common phase accuracy, and image restoration algorithms. First, a reasonable pupil 
arrangement can effectively improve the spatial resolution of the system while maintaining 
image quality. Second, phase errors between subapertures can significantly degrade system 
image quality. Therefore, accurately estimating and compensating for the initial phase is 
crucial for achieving high-quality imaging. Furthermore, based on optimized subaperture 
arrangement and initial phase compensation, advanced image restoration methods can 
further improve system image quality. Furthermore, for target detection, acquiring as much 
target information as possible facilitates analysis of target characteristics. Using an optical 
synthetic aperture system to acquire spectral information about a target not only increases 
the dimensionality of target information but also expands the system's capabilities. In 
response to the above key issues, this thesis conducts a detailed theoretical and experimental 
study on the optical synthetic aperture imaging system. The main research contents are as 
follows: 
 
Ⅰ. Analysis and optimization design of the influence of pupil structure on the imaging 
performance of the optical synthetic aperture system. The influence of filling factor on the 
point spread function, modulation transfer function and imaging quality of the GOLAY3 
structure is systematically analyzed. The optimal filling factor of the system is determined 
to be 0.37 while maintaining the imaging quality. The influence of sub-aperture obscuration 
ratio on system performance is further studied, and the maximum allowable obscuration ratio 
is 0.5. In order to solve the problems of high side lobes of point spread function and uneven 
intermediate frequency response of modulation transfer function in large array element

system.

aperture systems and phase estimation method. The effects of piston aberration, tilt 
aberration, and multi-order aberrations on the point spread function, modulation transfer

problem of the classical Stochastic Parallel Gradient Descent (SPGD) algorithm in multi-
order phase estimation by employing an adaptive gain coefficient-changing SPGD algorithm, 
which significantly improves convergence stability. Furthermore, the AdamSPGD algorithm, 
which introduces a momentum mechanism, effectively accelerates convergence and reduces 
estimation residuals. To address the high phase estimation residuals of the global phase 
difference method for the GOLAY3 structure, a segmented optimization phase estimation

functions, peak-Strehl Ratio and power-in-the-bucket-Strehl Ratio, are designed for piston 
and tilt aberration estimation. Using the proposed SR-PD estimation method, the estimated 
residuals of piston phase difference and tilt phase difference are reduced to 0.0001λ and 
0.0129λ respectively, and the overall estimated residual of the multi-order phase of the 
GOLAY3 structure is reduced to 0.0651λ.

I 
 
 
基于加权关键帧与FSC-McCNN 的浮选过程双目相机标定 
 
摘要：泡沫浮选过程中表层泡沫的立体结构信息直接反映生产过程优
劣，相机标定是进行表层泡沫三维形态重构的基础和关键。工业浮选
现场外部环境复杂多变，关键监测目标通常不包含平行直线、二次曲
线等特定的几何特征。同时设备安装空间受限、标定操作受限，不能
为相机标定提供精确的相机移动信息，难以获取具有理想位姿的高质
量标定图像，使得现有标定方法难以满足浮选过程的标定需求。为此，
以锌浮选过程的双目立体视觉系统为研究对象，研究基于加权关键帧
与FSC-McCNN 的浮选过程相机标定方法。 
论文主要围绕“失焦平面板图像复原”、
“浮选过程相机内参标定”、
“双目特征点同步校正”和“双目相机外参标定”四个挑战开展研究，
提出基于分块掩码调制U 形网络(ROI-Patched Mask Adaptive 
Modulation-UNet，RPMU-NET)的浮选过程失焦平面板图像复原方法、
基于关键帧提取和位姿加权的浮选过程相机内参标定方法、基于闭环
混合优化的双目特征点同步校正方法和基于特征编码卷积网络
(Feature Spatial Coding-Multi-channel Convolutional Neural Networks，
FSC-McCNN)的浮选过程双目外参标定方法，并在此基础上形成泡沫
浮选过程相机标定系统。论文的主要研究工作和创新性成果如下： 
(1) 针对因平面板倾斜、成像距离差异导致的标定板图像失焦模
糊、标定效率低的问题，提出了基于RPMU-NET 的浮选过程失焦平
面板图像复原方法。该方法针对圆形标定板构建了基于自适应掩码调
制的编码解码器模型MAM-UNet，通过对泡沫图像的感兴趣区域执
行特征引导的图像块分割操作来提升模型效率，并利用CUDA 线程
阵列对具有不同模糊程度的特征区块实施并行计算，同时引入渐进式
策略训练深度复原网络，为相机内参标定提供高精度特征。 
(2) 针对因操作环境受限、标定板非线性运动、位姿不可控等因
素导致的基于泡沫视频进行相机内参标定难的问题，提出了基于关键
帧提取和位姿加权的浮选过程相机内参标定方法。在进行失焦平面板
图像复原的基础上，利用标定物几何特征从原始泡沫视频中提取高质

 
II 
 
量图像序列，通过量化平面板倾斜度构建图像质量评价模型，以提取
泡沫视频内参关键帧，同时引入图像质量差异来计算关键帧图像序列
的位姿权重，并使用加权归一化位姿差异求解相机内参，提高了浮选
过程相机内参标定的鲁棒性。 
(3) 针对浮选过程复杂外部光源环境及硬件差异导致的双目相
机成像时间异步的问题，提出了基于闭环混合优化的双目特征点同步
校正方法。该方法构建了浮选过程双目相机的时间序列模型，通过双
目时序分析进行左右相机初始延时估计；为适应浮选过程平面板的随
机运动，使用特征匹配点预测方法从左右视图序列中提取右相机特征
匹配点坐标；最后，利用差分进化算法和希尔爬升算法研发了闭环混
合优化模型，以实现异步双目特征点的闭环校正，提升了异步相机的
特征匹配度，为准确的双目相机外参标定奠定了基础。 
(4) 针对浮选过程液位波动、相机视角变化等情况下双目外参高
精度标定能力受限的问题，提出了基于FSC-McCNN 的浮选过程双目
外参标定方法。该方法在进行双目特征点同步校正的基础上，进行双
目相机参数初始化，利用无畸变的虚拟成像场景构建了表征特征图谱
和相机参数之间映射关系的合成数据集，实施了基于边界约束的合成
数据增强，并研发了深度标定网络FSC-McCNN，深度挖掘不同位姿
特征图像的空间信息，提升了浮选过程双目相机外参标定性能。 
(5) 结合本文研究成果，搭建了泡沫浮选过程相机标定平台，研
发基于加权关键帧与FSC-McCNN 的浮选过程相机标定系统，应用于
某锌浮选过程的立体视觉系统，实现双目相机内外参数的有效标定，
应用效果良好，验证了所提理论和方法的有效性。

III 
 
 
 
Binocular Camera Calibration for Flotation Process Based 
on Weighted Keyframes and FSC-McCNN 
 
Abstract: The three-dimensional structural information of the surface 
froth in the flotation process directly reflects the quality of the production 
process, and camera calibration is the foundation and key to reconstructing 
the three-dimensional morphology of the surface froth. The external 
environment of industrial flotation sites is complex and variable, and the 
key monitoring targets usually do not contain specific geometric features 
such as parallel lines or quadratic curves. Additionally, limited installation 
space and operational constraints prevent the provision of precise camera 
movement information for calibration, making it difficult to obtain high-
quality calibration images with ideal poses. As a result, existing calibration 
methods struggle to meet the calibration requirements of the flotation 
process. Therefore, this study focuses on the binocular stereo vision system 
of the zinc flotation process and investigates a camera calibration method 
based on weighted keyframes and FSC-McCNN for the flotation process. 
The thesis primarily addresses four challenges: "defocused calibration 
plate image restoration," "camera intrinsic parameter calibration for the 
flotation process," "binocular feature point synchronization correction," 
and "binocular camera extrinsic parameter calibration." It proposes a 
defocused calibration pattern image restoration method for the flotation 
process based on ROI-Patched Mask Adaptive Modulation-UNet (RPMU-
NET), a camera intrinsic parameter calibration method based on keyframe 
extraction and pose weighting, a binocular feature point synchronization 
correction method based on closed-loop hybrid optimization, and a 
binocular extrinsic parameter calibration method for the flotation process 
based on Feature Spatial Coding-Multi-channel Convolutional Neural 
Networks (FSC-McCNN). On this basis, a camera calibration system for 
the froth flotation process is developed. The main research work and 

 
IV 
 
innovative achievements of the thesis are as follows: 
(1) To address the issues of defocused and blurred calibration plate 
images and low calibration efficiency caused by the tilt of the planar plate 
and differences in imaging distance, a defocused plate image restoration 
method for the flotation process based on RPMU-NET is proposed. This 
method constructs an encoder-decoder model, MAM-UNet, based on 
adaptive mask modulation for circular plates. It improves model efficiency 
by performing feature-guided image patch segmentation on regions of 
interest in froth images, and utilizes CUDA thread arrays for parallel 
computation of feature blocks with varying degrees of blur. Additionally, a 
progressive strategy is introduced to train the deep network, providing 
high-precision features for camera intrinsic parameter calibration. 
(2) Aiming at the difficulty of camera intrinsic calibration based on 
froth videos caused by factors such as restricted operating environments, 
non-linear motion of planar plate, and uncontrollable poses, a flotation 
process camera intrinsic calibration method based on keyframe extraction 
and pose weighting is proposed. Building on the restoration of defocused 
calibration plate images, high-quality image sequences are extracted from 
the original froth video using the geometric features of the calibration 
object. An image quality evaluation model is constructed by quantifying 
the tilt of the planar plate to extract intrinsic parameter keyframes from the 
froth video. The pose weights of the keyframe image sequence are 
calculated based on image quality differences, and the camera intrinsic 
parameters are solved using weighted normalized pose differences, 
improving the robustness of camera intrinsic parameter calibration for the 
flotation process. 
(3) To address the issue of asynchronous imaging times in binocular 
cameras caused by complex external lighting environments and hardware 
differences in the flotation process, a binocular feature point 
synchronization correction method based on closed-loop hybrid 
optimization is proposed. This method constructs a time series model for 
the binocular cameras in the flotation process and estimates the initial delay 
between the left and right cameras through binocular temporal analysis. To 
adapt to the random motion of the planar plate in the flotation process, a 

 
V 
 
feature matching point prediction method is used to extract the coordinates 
of feature matching points from the right camera's view sequence. Finally, 
a closed-loop hybrid optimization model is developed using differential 
evolution and hill-climbing algorithms to achieve closed-loop correction 
of asynchronous binocular feature points, improving the feature matching 
accuracy of asynchronous cameras and laying the foundation for accurate 
binocular camera extrinsic parameter calibration. 
(4) To address the limitations of high-precision binocular extrinsic 
parameter calibration in the flotation process under conditions such as 
liquid level fluctuations and changes in camera perspective, a binocular 
extrinsic parameter calibration method for the flotation process based on 
FSC-McCNN is proposed. Building on the synchronization correction of 
binocular feature points, this method initializes the binocular camera 
parameters and constructs a synthetic dataset representing the mapping 
relationship between feature maps and camera parameters using a 
distortion-free virtual imaging scene. Data augmentation based on 
boundary constraints is implemented, and a deep calibration network, FSC-
McCNN, is developed to deeply explore the spatial information of feature 
images from different poses, improving the performance of binocular 
camera extrinsic parameter calibration for the flotation process. 
(5) Combining the research results of this thesis, a camera calibration 
platform for the froth flotation process is established, and a camera 
calibration system based on weighted keyframes and FSC-McCNN is 
developed. This system is applied to the stereo vision system of a zinc 
flotation process, achieving effective calibration of the intrinsic and 
extrinsic parameters of the binocular cameras. The application results are 
satisfactory, validating the effectiveness of the proposed theories and 
methods. 
 
 
Keywords: Camera calibration; out-of-focus image restoration; key frame 
extraction; deep calibration network; binocular vision system; binocular 
feature point correction; froth flotation

摘  要 
- I - 
基于机器视觉的铜带表面缺陷智能检测研究 
摘要：铜带作为电子信息和航空航天等领域的重要基础材料，其表面质量直接关系
到后续加工性能与产品可靠性。目前，许多生产现场仍采用人工目测方法进行表面
缺陷检测，这种方法精度低、劳动强度大，存在较高的安全风险。少部分企业引进
了无损检测技术，但在实际应用中存在设备复杂、通用性较差、检出缺陷类别少、
成本高等问题。随着人工智能理论的发展以及受到人工目测方法的启发，基于机器
视觉的智能检测技术逐渐成为实现表面缺陷检测的有效途径。然而，该技术在实际
应用仍面临成像环境复杂、样本稀缺及模型部署受限等挑战。为此，本文以铜带表
面缺陷检测为研究对象，以深度学习理论与机器视觉技术为支撑，系统研究了非均
匀光照恢复、图像去雾、多源数据增强、轻量化智能检测、铜带智能分割与位置辅
助检测等关键技术，旨在提供一套通用性和实用性强的智能化解决方案。 
为应对复杂工业环境对成像质量的干扰，分别针对非均匀光照与雾气干扰两种
典型图像退化场景开展图像复原方法研究。对于非均匀光照退化场景，通过实验室
采集少量配对样本，并基于Retinex成像理论提出一种非均匀光照退化图像合成方法，
构建了铜带表面非均匀光照退化数据集。同时，引入基于Laplacian 金字塔分解的非
均匀光照校正框架，以此得到的复原模型能够恢复由于光照不均造成的缺陷特征丢
失，增强图像的视觉效果。对于冷轧中的雾气干扰退化场景，在冷轧现场采集了真
实生产数据，并基于大气散射模型提出一种雾气退化图像合成方法，构建了铜带表
面雾气退化数据集。采用一种两阶段弱监督去雾框架，可以有效恢复铜带表面纹理
与缺陷特征，显著降低雾气对检测性能的干扰。 
针对工业生产中铜带表面缺陷样本规模有限、类间分布不均衡的问题，提出一
种多源数据融合策略。在少量真实缺陷样本基础上，引入生成模型生成高质量、多
样化缺陷样本，并建立了融合真实样本、标准增强样本、mixup 样本与生成样本的多
源数据驱动范式，显著增加了样本规模并缓解了类间不均衡问题。 
为实现缺陷智能检测模型的高效部署，设计了自适应部分卷积算子APConv，通
过引入通道注意力机制增强特征表达能力。为实现多尺度信息的高效融合，通过融
合高效多尺度注意力机制构建了具有残差结构的EAPR_Block 模块，进而搭建轻量
化高效主干网络EAPRNet，以此为基础对RT-DETR 进行轻量化改进。实验结果表明，

- II - 
该方法训练的缺陷智能检测模型在保证高检测精度的同时，实现了推理速度的显著
提升，展现出优异的综合性能。 
针对冷轧生产中原始图像受复杂背景干扰的问题，本文构建了铜带区域快速智
能分割模型，作为图像预处理的重要环节，以实现铜带表面的准确提取，从而有效
降低无效计算并提升缺陷检测的精度。同时，结合分割结果提出了边缘位置提取算
法，用于实时计算铜带跑偏量，以保证缺陷定位信息的可靠性。最后，从硬件配置、
模型微调与部署和软件架构设计三个层面研制了一套具有较强通用性和实用性的铜
带表面缺陷检测系统，并在国内某冷轧铜带产线完成上机应用。 
关键词：铜带表面缺陷；机器视觉；深度学习；多源数据驱动；图像复原；工业检
测

Abstract 
- III - 
Research on Intelligent Surface Defects Detection of 
Copper Strip Based on Machine Vision 
Abstract: Copper strips serve as pivotal foundational materials in electronics and 
aerospace. Consequently, their surface quality is a critical determinant of downstream 
processing performance and product reliability. Currently, many production lines still rely 
on manual visual inspection, a method hindered by low accuracy, high labor intensity, and 
significant safety risks. Although some enterprises have adopted nondestructive testing 
technologies, their practical application is often limited by equipment complexity, poor 
generalizability, few detectable defect categories, and high costs. With the advancement of 
artificial intelligence, machine vision-based intelligent detection has emerged as an 
effective approach for surface defect inspection. However, its industrial application still 
faces significant challenges, including data scarcity, complex imaging environments, and 
model deployment constraints. Therefore, this dissertation focuses on the surface defect 
detection of copper strip. Supported by deep learning theory and machine vision 
technology, it systematically investigates key technologies such as non-uniform 
illumination restoration, image dehazing, multi-source data augmentation, lightweight 
intelligent detection, and intelligent strip segmentation with position-assisted measurement, 
aiming to provide a generalized and practical intelligent solution. 
To mitigate the impact of complex industrial environments on imaging quality, this 
study focuses on two representative degradation scenarios: non-uniform illumination and 
haze interference. For the non-uniform illumination scenario, a degradation dataset was 
constructed by synthesizing images based on Retinex theory, using a limited number of 
paired samples collected under laboratory conditions. A correction framework based on 
Laplacian pyramid decomposition was introduced, through which the resulting restoration 
model effectively recovered defect features obscured by non-uniform illumination and 
enhanced overall visual quality. For haze degradation, real industrial production data were 
collected, and a haze-degraded dataset was established based on the atmospheric scattering 
model. A two-stage weakly supervised dehazing framework was employed, which 

燕山大学工学博士学位论文 
- IV - 
effectively restored surface textures and defect features and significantly reduced the 
adverse impact of haze on detection performance. 
To address the challenges of data scarcity and imbalanced class distribution in copper 
strip surface defect detection, a multi-source data fusion strategy is proposed. Leveraging 
a limited set of authentic defect samples, generative models are employed to synthesize 
high-quality and diverse defect images. Furthermore, a multi-source data-driven paradigm 
is established by integrating authentic samples with data from standard augmentation, 
mixup techniques, and generative models. Consequently, this approach significantly 
expands the dataset scale and effectively mitigates the issue of class imbalance. 
To facilitate the efficient deployment of intelligent defect detection models, an 
Adaptive Partial Convolution operator incorporating a channel attention mechanism was 
designed to enhance feature representation capabilities. To achieve efficient fusion of 
multi-scale information, an EAPR_Block module featuring a residual structure was 
constructed by integrating an EMA mechanism. Subsequently, a lightweight and efficient 
backbone network, termed EAPRNet, was developed. This backbone serves as the 
foundation for the lightweight optimization of the RT-DETR. Experimental results 
demonstrate that the proposed model maintains high detection accuracy while significantly 
accelerating inference speed, thereby exhibiting superior comprehensive performance. 
To address interference from complex backgrounds in raw images, a fast intelligent 
segmentation model for the copper strip region was developed as a crucial preprocessing 
step. This model accurately extracts the strip surface, effectively reducing redundant 
computations and improving detection accuracy. Concurrently, an edge position extraction 
algorithm based on the segmentation results was proposed to calculate strip deviation in 
real-time. Finally, a comprehensive and practical surface defect detection system was 
developed, integrating hardware configuration, model fine-tuning and deployment, and 
software architecture design. The system was successfully deployed on a domestic 
cold-rolled copper strip production line.  
Keywords: copper strip surface defects; machine vision; deep learning; multi-source 
data-driven; image restoration; industrial detection

摘要 
I 
基于水下光学图像清晰化的目标检测方法研究 
摘 要 
水下光学成像系统作为理解和感知水下环境的重要工具之一，广泛用于水下
目标自主搜寻以及水下目标探测等领域。然而，由于水介质对不同波长光的选择性
吸收和散射效应、以及水中悬浮颗粒物等因素的耦合作用，导致水下光学图像普遍
存在对比度低、颜色偏差、细节模糊和非均匀光照等降质问题，从而影响后续目标
检测任务的精度和鲁棒性。因此，本论文针对波长选择性光吸收和散射效应导致的
颜色失真、人工光源引入的非均匀照明以及不同退化类型水下图像中的非均匀退
化等问题，研究图像清晰化方法以提升图像的整体视觉感知和对关键目标特征的
敏感度。此外，目标检测是水下光学应用的另一项关键方法。传统的目标检测方法
主要依赖于人工设计的特征信息，难以准确描述水下多尺度和非刚性变形的目标
物体，从而影响了目标检测方法的检测精度和泛化性。水介质特有的光学衰减以及
水下目标尺度变化大、遮挡与聚集等问题，进一步加剧了目标检测模型在水下场景
中的性能。因此，本论文从改善水下降质图像的质量入手，针对三种退化类型的水
下光学图像分别提出了相应的图像清晰化方法以提升图像的质量，并作为目标检
测任务的预处理步骤，从而提高目标检测模型的检测精度和鲁棒性。基于上述分析，
本论文的主要研究内容如下： 
（1）针对水介质波长依赖性光吸收和散射效应导致的颜色偏差、低对比度和
模糊等问题，提出基于局部白平衡和多尺度融合的水下图像清晰化方法。首先针对
水介质对不同光谱区域光的吸收特性，将通道补偿策略和细化亮度图相结合，以改
善水下光学图像中不同程度的色偏问题。其次，根据颜色校正图像的高频信息设计
多尺度融合策略的输入图像，并采用统计学设计通用的清晰度权重图和亮度权重
图以增强水下图像的视觉质量。本章方法在UCCS、UIEB、UIQS 和RISU 水下图
像数据集上开展了广泛的定性与定量实验。定性结果表明，所提方法可有效校正水
下图像中不同程度的颜色失真现象，并提升图像的纹理信息。此外，引入UIQM、
UCIQE、FADE、AG 和EI 定量评价指标进一步验证本章方法在多样化水下环境中
的有效性。 
（2）针对水下非均匀照明问题，提出基于亮度图估计和自适应增益的水下图
像清晰化方法。首先采用颜色空间变换和线性拉伸操作生成颜色转移图像，并引入

昆明理工大学博士学位论文 
II 
最大衰减图动态调整水下图像的颜色信息，从而获得颜色校正图像。其次，通过施
加结构权重矩阵以处理水下图像中非均匀照明的挑战。此外，通过引入积分图分解
图像的低频信息，并提出自适应增益控制函数实现图像高频信息的自适应增强，以
解决水下光学图像中纹理细节信息弱化的问题。实验结果表明，所提方法能够有效
抑制水下非均匀照明的干扰。在工业水下环境进行的双目视觉标定实验中，该方法
分别获得了0.167 的重投影误差和28.20mm 的实际测量距离值，均优于对比方法。 
（3）针对不同类型水下光学图像降质过程中的非均匀退化问题，提出基于成
像模型和衰减图引导的水下图像清晰化方法。首先构建了一个多颜色通道混洗模
块以结合图像中不同颜色空间的视觉表征，并引入衰减图对不同类型图像的局部
区域提供非均匀增强。随后，引入多分支结构和空洞卷积估计不同颜色通道的透射
图，并将水下物理模型嵌入到统一的框架中以实现端到端水下图像增强。本章方法
在UIEB 测试、UIEB 挑战、EUVP、LSUI 和SQUID 水下数据集上开展了全面的
定性与定量实验。定性结果表明，所提方法能够有效改善不同类型水下光学图像的
视觉感知效果，并提升了图像的全局和局部对比度。此外，引入全参考和无参考定
量评价指标进一步验证本章方法在处理水下非均匀退化问题方法的能力。 
（4）针对水下目标的堆叠、边缘模糊以及多种图像降质的问题，提出基于图
像增强和多分支结构的水下目标检测方法。首先研究不同类型水下图像清晰化方
法的适用情况，设计条件判定模块为目标检测网络提供高质量的输入图像。其次，
为了解决水下目标尺度变化大、遮挡以及聚集等问题，通过引入拉普拉斯算子构建
特征输入模块可捕获图像更深层次的边缘特征，并基于注意力机制和多尺度结构
设计骨干网络和颈部网络，提高了水下目标检测模型的有效性和鲁棒性。实验结果
表明，所提方法可显著提高目标检测模型在不同退化程度水下图像中的性能。此外，
在水下抓取任务中，进一步验证了所提方法在实际水下环境中的适用性。 
本文研究不仅从理论与应用的角度系统验证了所提出方法的有效性，还针对
水下抓取任务构建了基于视觉的水下自动抓取实验平台，进一步验证了本论文方
法在实际水下场景中的适用性。 
关键词：水下图像清晰化；图像退化；图像融合；颜色空间变换；卷积神经网络 
 
 
 
 
 

Abstract 
III 
Object Detection Method Based on Underwater Optical 
Image Sharpening 
Abstract 
The underwater optical imaging system is one of the important tools for 
understanding and perceiving the underwater environment, which is widely used in the 
autonomous search for underwater objects, underwater object detection and other fields. 
However, due to the selective absorption and scattering of the different wavelengths of 
light and the combined effects of microorganisms, underwater images often suffer from 
contrast reduction, color deviation, blurred details, and non-uniform illumination, which 
influences the accuracy and robustness of subsequent object detection tasks. Therefore, 
this thesis’s dedicated underwater optical image sharpening method is studied to improve 
the overall visual perception of the image and sensitivity to key object features, including 
the color distortion caused by wavelength-dependent light absorption and scattering, the 
non-uniform illumination introduced by artificial light sources, and the non-uniform 
degradation in underwater images of different types. Additionally, object detection model 
is another key technology for underwater optical applications. Traditional object detection 
models depend on artificially designed feature information, but this feature information 
is incapable of adequately describing the underwater multi-scale and non-rigidly 
deformed objects, thus limiting the effectiveness and generalization of subsequent object 
detection models. Due to the unique characteristics of the water medium, the quality of 
underwater images may be degraded, and the multi-scale, occlusion, and aggregation 
characteristics of underwater objects also pose challenges to the performance of object 
detection models. Therefore, starting from improving the quality of degraded underwater 
images, three underwater optical image sharpening methods are proposed to enhance the 
quality of underwater images with different degradation types and serve as a 
preprocessing step for the object detection task, thus improving the detection accuracy 
and robustness of the object detection model. Based on the above analysis, the main 
research of this thesis is summarized as follows: 
(1) Aiming at the problems of color deviation, low contrast and blur caused by 

昆明理工大学博士学位论文 
IV 
wavelength-dependent light absorption and scattering effects, an underwater image 
sharpening method based on local white balance and multi-scale fusion is proposed. 
Firstly, a channel compensation strategy and a refined brightness map are combined to 
reflect the light absorption of the water medium in different spectral regions to correct the 
color deviation of underwater images. Secondly, a multi-scale fusion strategy is 
constructed based on the high-frequency information of the color-corrected image, and 
then a generalized sharpness and brightness weight map is designed based on a statistics 
method to enhance the visual quality of underwater images. Extensive qualitative and 
quantitative experiments have been conducted on the UCCS, UIEB, UIQS and RISU 
underwater image datasets. Qualitative results show that the proposed method can 
effectively correct various degrees of color distortion and enhance the texture details of 
the underwater images. Moreover, the UIQM, UCIQE, FADE, AG and EI quantitative 
evaluation metrics are introduced to further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed 
method in diverse underwater environments. 
(2) Aiming at the problem of underwater non-uniform illumination, an underwater 
image sharpening method based on illumination map estimation and adaptive gain is 
proposed. Firstly, color space transformation and linear stretching operation are utilized 
to derive the color transfer image, and the maximum attenuation map is introduced to 
dynamically adjust the color information to obtain the color-corrected image. Then, the 
challenge of non-uniform in underwater images is tackled by imposing a structure weight 
matrix. In addition, the integral map is introduced to decompose the low-frequency 
information of the image, and an adaptive gain control function is proposed to adaptively 
enhance the high-frequency information to solve the problem of weakened texture detail 
in underwater optical images. Experimental results show that the proposed method can 
effectively suppress the interference of underwater non-uniform illumination. In the 
industrial underwater binocular vision calibration experiment, the proposed method 
obtains a reprojection error of 0.167 and an actual measurement distance value of 
28.20mm, which are better than the comparison method. 
(3) Aiming at the non-uniform degradation problem in the degradation process of 
underwater optical images with different types, an underwater image sharpening method 
based on imaging model and attenuation guidance is proposed. Firstly, a multi-color 
channel shuffle module is constructed to combine the visual representations of different 

Abstract 
V 
color spaces, and an attenuation map is introduced to provide non-uniform enhancement 
for local regions of images with different types. Subsequently, a multi-branch structure 
and dilated convolution are introduced to estimate transmission maps for different color 
channels and integrate the underwater physical model into a unified framework to achieve 
end-to-end underwater image enhancement. Comprehensive qualitative and quantitative 
experiments have been conducted on the UIEB test, UIEB challenge, EUVP, LSUI and 
SQUID underwater datasets. Qualitative results show that the proposed method can 
effectively improve the visual perception of different types of underwater optical images 
and enhance the global and local contrast of the image. Moreover, full-reference and no-
reference quantitative evaluation metrics are introduced to further verify the ability of the 
proposed method in dealing with underwater non-uniform degradation problems. 
(4) Aiming at handling the problems of underwater target occlusion, edge blur and 
various image degradation, an underwater object detection method based on image 
enhancement and multi-branch structure is proposed. Firstly, the applicability of different 
underwater image sharpening methods is studied to provide high-quality images for the 
object detection network. Secondly, due to the multi-scale, occlusion, and aggregation of 
underwater targets, the Laplacian operator is introduced to construct the feature input 
module to enhance the edge features extract ability of the model. Moreover, the backbone 
and neck networks are designed based on the attention mechanism and multi-scale 
structure to improve the effectiveness and robustness of the underwater object detection 
model. Experimental results show the proposed method can significantly improve the 
performance of the target detection model in underwater images with different 
degradation levels. Moreover, the applicability of the proposed methods in actual 
underwater environments are further tested via underwater grasping tasks. 
Throughout the thesis, the effectiveness of the proposed methods is verified both 
theoretically and in application. Moreover, the applicability of the proposed methods in 
actual underwater environments are further tested via underwater grasping tasks. 
Key Words: Underwater optical image sharpening; Image degradation; Image fusion; 
Color space transformation; Convolutional neural network

Research on Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy 
Image Analysis Algorithm for Based on GI 
Diseases 
 
 
 
 
By ZHOU Jingjun 
Supervisor: LIU Qian 
Information and Communication Engineering 
School of Information and Communication Engineering 
May, 2025

 
I 
摘要 
共聚焦内窥镜（Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy，CLE）作为一种新型光学活检成
像技术，凭借其独特的细胞级分辨率和实时在体成像能力，已成为消化道肿瘤早期诊
断的重要临床检查手段。然而，CLE探头的光纤束结构会影响图像质量，且病变形态
复杂多样、组织边缘模糊，肿瘤病理分级的准确性高度依赖医师临床经验，而专业医
师的培养周期较长，亟需解决上述问题。因此，开发消化道疾病早期精准诊疗的图像
处理方法具有重要临床应用价值，其不仅能提升临床决策的准确性并降低人为失误，
还能增强医疗资源匮乏地区在疾病早期发现和及时治疗方面的可及性。本文以消化道
CLE医学图像为研究对象，围绕图像处理的全过程，开展了CLE图像去噪、分割和识
别等关键技术研究，并结合其他模态消化道医学图像进行临床需求分析。具体研究内
容如下： 
（1）针对共聚焦内窥镜成像过程中产生各种形式的噪声，本研究提出了基于物
理成像真实噪声统计分布特性的自监督去噪方法，摆脱了对配对无噪声干净图像的依
赖。通过设计具有自适应区域权重与适度感受野动态调节的上下文感知核估计模块，
有效应对噪声分布不均，构建了轻量级去噪模型CLENet。多尺度动态融合模块通过
特征解耦与跨尺度交互实现上下文信息的动态校准。将上述模块集成到U型架构中，
构建了高效去噪网络U-CLENet。实验结果表明，所提出的方法在保持较低计算复杂
度的同时，其去噪性能与现有方法相当甚至更优，为后续CLE图像分析任务提供了高
质量的预处理结果。 
（2）针对消化道病变类型形态多样性及组织边界模糊等挑战，本研究提出了一
种金字塔ViT多尺度混合结构的消化道图像分割方法PMHNet，通过将三个模块与金
字塔Transformer结合，学习更强大且稳健的特征。这三个模块分别为包括密集门控连
接模块（Dense Gated Connection，DGC），自多尺度交互融合模块（Self Multi-Scale 
Interaction Fusion，SMSF）和多尺度注意力解码模块（Multi-scale Attention Decoding，
MAD），用于提取和融合医学图像的多尺度上下文信息。DGC通过密集门控特征融
合机制级联局部语义特征，减少浅层背景特征干扰，缓解病灶尺寸与类型差异。SMSF
利用自多尺度多头注意力融合局部与全局特征，引导网络关注感兴趣区域，应对病变

 
II 
与周围组织相似的问题。MAD通过级联多尺度语义特征，细化特征以实现精确分割。
该方法在共聚焦内窥镜人体消化道腺体、共聚焦内窥镜动物结肠隐窝、病理图像腺体
和电子内窥镜息肉分割任务分别取得了90.35%/94.68%、81.60%/89.81%、86.86%/92.65%
和77.49%/84.31%的mIoU/mDice指标。定量与定性分析结果表明，PMHNet在分割准确
性和泛化性方面均优于现有方法，为后续CLE图像分类任务提供了精准可靠的腺体解
剖结构形态学依据以提升分类数据人工标注效率及模型可解释性。 
（3）针对CLE图像数据集中存在的类间方差小和类内方差大及标注数据稀缺等
挑战，本研究提出了一种聚类引导的双对比学习方法CTCL，旨在提高CLE图像的判
别性表征，增强消化道CLE图像的分类性能。与传统对比学习方法不同，CTCL通过
实例级和簇级双对比学习对齐更多语义相关且类别一致的样本，从而增强类内紧凑性
和类间可分性，获得更具信息性的特征。此外，基于CLE的固有特性，本研究进一步
提出将任意角度旋转和不同噪声的CLE图像分别视为同一实例，以增加特征的多样性。
最后，通过端到端的期望最大化算法迭代优化CTCL框架。实验结果表明，CTCL在线
性评估和小样本学习下游任务中分别取得了75.60%/78.45%和64.12%/77.37%的准确
率，优于现自监督学习和监督学习方法，且展现出更优的鲁棒性和泛化性。 
（4）针对CTCL缺乏对图像内及图像间局部相似区域相关性建模等挑战，本研究
提出了一种结合对比学习和词袋模型的多任务学习方法CB-MTL，通过自监督学习更
有效地从未标注的CLE图像中提取判别性表征。该方法的主任务为对比学习，学习具
有变换不变的图像表征，辅助任务则采用词袋模型，捕捉与结构和内容相关的局部特
征，增强对比学习的鲁棒性。通过这种方式，CB-MTL能够实现变换不变的预测，并
有效地捕捉图像的结构和内容相关信息。实验结果表明，该方法在多个下游任务中取
得77.61%/81.82%/75.83%的准确率，验证了词袋模型的有效性，并显著提升了CLE图
像分析性能。值得注意的是，CB-MTL在CNN和Transformer架构中均表现优异，进一
步表明了词袋模型能够显著提升对比学习的表征质量，且无需额外标注数据。 
本研究构建的计算机辅助诊断系统在图像质量增强、病灶定位和病理分级分类等
关键环节均取得了突破，有助于为消化道肿瘤的精准诊疗提供新的技术支撑。 
：消化道医学图像；深度学习；共聚焦内窥镜图像；图像去噪；图像分割；
图像分类

 
III 
ABSTRACT 
As a novel optical biopsy imaging technology, Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy (CLE) 
has become important clinical examination technique for early diagnosis of GI tumors due 
to its unique real-time imaging capability with cellular-level resolution. However, the fiber-
optic bundle structure of the CLE probe affects the image quality, the morphology of lesion 
tissues is complex and diverse with blurred edge features, and the accuracy of tumor 
pathology grading is highly dependent on physicians' clinical experience, which requires a 
long period of professional training, and this presents an urgent need for improvement. 
Therefore, the development of image processing methods for the early and accurate 
diagnosis and treatment of GI diseases has significant clinical value, which which not only 
improves the accuracy of clinical decision-making and reduces human errors, but also 
enhances the accessibility of areas with scarce medical resources in terms of early disease 
detection and timely treatment. In this study, we take GI CLE medical images as the research 
object, focus on the whole process of image processing, conduct research on the key 
technologies of CLE image denoising, segmentation and recognition. In addition, utilizing 
GI medical images from other modalities, we integrated clinical requirements for further 
analysis and investigation. The specific research contents are as follows: 
(1) For the various types of noise that CLE inevitably generates during the imaging 
process, a self-supervised denoising method based on physical imaging characteristics is 
proposed to eliminate the dependence on paired noise-free clean images. The context-aware 
kernel estimation module with adaptive region weighting and moderate sensory field 
dynamic adjustment is designed to effectively deal with the non-uniformity of noise 
distribution, and a lightweight denoising model CLENet is constructed. The multi-scale 
dynamic fusion module is designed to provide dynamic calibration of contextual information 
through feature decoupling and cross-scale interaction. Finally, we integrate two developed 
modules into a U-shaped backbone to build an efficient denoising network named U-
CLENet. Both proposed methods achieve comparable or even better performance with low 
computational complexity to provide high-quality preprocessing results for subsequent CLE 
image analysis tasks. 
(2) To address the challenges of morphological diversity and blurred tissue boundaries 
of GI lesions, a Pyramid Multi-Scale Hybrid Network PMHNet is proposed to learn more 

 
IV 
powerful and robust features through integrating three modules with Pyramid Transformer. 
The proposed modules include Dense Gated Connection (DGC), Self Multi-Scale 
Interaction Fusion (SMSF), and Multi-Scale Attention Decoding (MAD) for extraction and 
fusion of multiscale contextual information from medical images. The DGC employed a 
dense gated feature fusion mechanism to cascade local semantic feature information, which 
minimized shallow background noise and alleviates the variations in lesion size and type. 
Additionally, SMSF directed the network to focus on regions of interest by fusing local and 
global features through self-multi-scale multi-head attention, effectively mitigating the 
challenge posed by the similarity of lesions to surrounding tissues. Lastly, MAD refined 
features for accurate segmentation by cascading multi-scale semantic feature information. 
Experimental results show that PMHNet has achieved excellent performance on multiple 
datasets, and achieves mIoU/ mDice of 90.35%/94.68%, 81.60%/89.81%, 86.86%/92.65%, 
and 77.49%/84.31% in the CLE human GI glands, CLE animal colonic crypt, pathological 
image gland, and electronic endoscopic polyp segmentation tasks, respectively. The results 
of quantitative and qualitative analyses indicate that PMHNet outperformed existing 
methods in terms of segmentation accuracy and generalization to provide an accurate and 
reliable morphological basis of glandular anatomical structure for the subsequent CLE image 
classification task to improve the manual annotation efficiency and model interpretability. 
(3) In order to address the challenges of small interclass variance and large intraclass 
variance and scarcity of labeled data in the CLE image dataset, a novel clustering-guided 
twin-contrastive learning framework CTCL is proposed to improve the discriminative 
representation of CLE images for GI tumor classification. Compared with traditional 
contrastive learning, CTCL aligns more semantically related and class-consistent samples 
by clustering, which improves intra-class tightness and inter-class variability to produce 
more informative representations. Furthermore, based on the inherent properties of CLE, we 
proposed to regard CLE images with any angle rotation and CLE images with different 
noises as the same instance, respectively, for increased variability and diversity of samples. 
Finally, the CTCL is iteratively optimized by an end-to-end expectation maximization 
algorithm. Experimental results show that CTCL achieved 75.60%/78.45% and 
64.12%/77.37% top-1 accuracy on the linear evaluation protocol and few-shot classification 
downstream tasks, respectively, which outperform the existing state-of-the-art SSL and 
supervised methods, and exhibits better robustness and transferability. 
(4) In response to challenges of CTCL lack of modeling the relevance of locally similar 
regions within and between images, a multi-task learning algorithm CB-MTL is proposed 
that combines contrastive learning and bag-of-words to learn more robust visual 

 
V 
representations from unlabeled CLE data through self-supervised learning. The main task is 
a contrastive learning task for learning transformation-invariant representations, while the 
auxiliary task involves a bag-of-words objective to capture structural and content-related 
information from diverse local similarity regions to enhance the robustness and 
generalization of the main task. In this way, CB-MTL enables transform-invariant prediction 
and effectively captures structural and content-related information of images. Experimental 
results show that the method achieves 77.61%/81.82%/75.83% accuracy in multiple 
downstream tasks, validates the effectiveness of the bag-of-words, and significantly 
improves the CLE image analysis performance. Notably, CB-MTL works across both CNN 
and Transformer architectures and shows that BoW significantly improves the quality of 
representation for contrastive learning on both CLE image datasets without requiring 
additional annotations. 
The computer-aided diagnosis system constructed in this study has made breakthroughs 
in crucial aspects of image quality enhancement, lesion localization and pathology grading 
and classification, which can help to provide new technical support for the precise diagnosis 
and treatment of GI tumors. 
Key Words: GI medical image, Deep learning, Confocal laser endomicroscopy image, 
Image denoising, Image segmentation, Image classification

复杂水体环境目标偏振探测技术研究 
 
 
 
作者姓名：                  杨环宇                     
指导教师:                 张达 研究员                  
             中国科学院长春光学精密机械与物理研究所    
学位类别:                  工学博士                    
学科专业:                  光学工程

2025 年 6 月 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Research on the Polarization Detection of Targets 
 in  Complex Water Environments

By

Supervisor: Professor Zhang Da 
 
 
 
 
 Changchun Institute of Optics, Fine Mechanics and Physics,

摘  要 
I 
摘  要 
近年来，水下地形测绘、海底资源勘探、海洋生态监测、水下目标识别与
救援等应用对水下目标探测技术提出了更高要求。然而，传统水下声学成像系
统存在分辨率低、采集与处理效率低下、难以实现实时高分辨率成像等问题，
已难以满足上述应用需求。相比之下，水下光学成像技术具备成像分辨率高、
处理速度快、视觉信息丰富等优势，且能够直接获取符合人类认知模式的图像
信息，显著降低对专业声呐解译的依赖，因而在近年得到了快速发展与广泛关
注。 
水下偏振成像探测技术是一种将偏振信息引入水下光学成像的新型方法，
仅需在传统水下成像系统中增加一个偏振信息探测模块，通过采集同一目标在
多个偏振状态下的强度图像，即可实现对目标全偏振信息的获取，包括偏振度、
偏振角和椭圆偏振率等特征。在复杂水体环境中，尤其是强散射背景下，偏振
成像技术相较于传统水下成像手段展现出更显著的优势。本文围绕三个关键方
向开展系统研究：水下偏振光传播的理论建模、水下偏振图像的恢复算法、以
及适用于水下环境的偏振成像光学系统设计。主要研究内容与创新成果如下： 
针对水下散射环境中偏振光传播的理论基础展开了深入研究，从Mie 散射
理论出发，推导了适用于水体环境的完整穆勒（Mueller）矩阵，详尽分析了光
在水体中传播过程中的散射与吸收机制。构建了一个基于物理建模的蒙特卡洛
仿真框架，引入完整散射矩阵精确描述任意粒子的散射行为，改进了传统仿真
中多采用各向同性或近似模型的简化假设，实现了从传播建模到图像层级输出
的全过程仿真。在不同水质条件下，分别对自然光与偏振光在不同深度的成像
表现进行模拟，结合三种图像质量评价方法，定量分析了水体对偏振信息传输
的影响。结果表明，偏振光在散射介质中具有更优的成像性能，为后续水下偏
振图像恢复算法的物理建模与性能提升奠定了坚实基础。 
针对水下偏振图像恢复算法展开研究，首先引入了适用于水下成像的光波
物理退化模型，深入分析了传统水下偏振方法的原理与局限。基于蒙特卡洛模
拟生成的水下散射图像，提取其偏振角矩阵并进行分析后发现，该矩阵在图像
中呈现出明显的区域性分布特征，可用于有效区分目标与背景区域。基于这一
特性，提出了一种偏振角分布驱动的自适应图像恢复算法，有效改善了传统算
法在实时性和复原质量方面的不足。该方法无需预设参数，具备良好的自适应
性，并在仿真与实际实验中均获得验证。定量分析结果表明，该算法在图像细
节增强与结构相似度提升方面表现出显著优势，对提升水下成像质量与实现实
时目标探测具有重要意义。 

复杂水体环境目标偏振探测技术研究 
II 
提出并设计了具备全偏振同步采集能力的水下成像镜头，将分孔径成像结
构引入水下偏振成像系统，实现了单帧获取完整斯托克斯参数，有效缓解了传
统水下多帧成像在实时性、结构复杂度与集成性方面难以兼顾的问题。设计中
结合水下与陆地成像环境的差异，对系统结构与关键参数进行了优化配置。最
终构建的光学系统在奈奎斯特频率（46 lp/mm）处的MTF 值均高于0.75，
5.5 μm 半径内圈入能量超过80%，边缘视场相对照度达到90%，在保证成像质
量的同时，实现了偏振信息的高效同步采集，为水下图像的实时获取与算法集
成提供了可部署的光学平台，具备在大视场、小型化、轻量化任务中的应用潜
力。 
 
关键词： 水下探测  偏振成像  自适应算法  图像恢复  光学设计

Abstract 
III 
Abstract 
In recent years, increasing demands have been placed on underwater target 
detection technologies due to a wide range of applications, including underwater 
topographic mapping, seabed resource exploration, marine ecological monitoring, 
underwater object identification, and rescue operations. However, traditional 
underwater acoustic imaging systems suffer from low spatial resolution, limited data 
acquisition and processing efficiency, and an inability to achieve real-time high-
resolution imaging, making them insufficient for meeting these growing needs. In 
contrast, underwater optical imaging technologies offer significant advantages such as 
higher imaging resolution, faster processing speed, and richer visual information. 
Moreover, optical imaging provides intuitive image data that aligns with human visual 
perception, thereby reducing the dependence on specialized sonar interpretation skills. 
As a result, optical imaging has seen rapid development and increasing attention in 
recent years. 
Underwater polarimetric imaging is an emerging technique that integrates 
polarization information into traditional optical imaging systems. By incorporating a 
polarization detection module into an existing underwater imaging setup, and acquiring 
intensity images of the same target under multiple polarization states, complete 
polarization information—including the degree of polarization, angle of polarization, 
and ellipticity—can be effectively obtained. In complex aquatic environments, 
particularly under strong scattering conditions, polarimetric imaging demonstrates 
significant advantages over conventional underwater optical imaging approaches. This 
research is conducted to systematically investigate three key aspects of underwater 
polarimetric imaging: the theoretical modeling of polarized light propagation in water, 
the development of polarization-based image restoration algorithms, and the optical 
design of imaging systems adapted to underwater environments. The main research 
content and contributions are summarized as follows: 
A thorough investigation was conducted into the theoretical foundations of 
polarized light propagation in underwater scattering environments. Starting from Mie 
scattering theory, a complete Mueller matrix applicable to aquatic media was derived, 
providing a detailed analysis of the scattering and absorption mechanisms involved in 
underwater light transmission. A physics-based Monte Carlo simulation framework was 
constructed, incorporating the full scattering matrix to accurately characterize the 
scattering behavior of arbitrary particles. This approach overcomes the simplified 
assumptions commonly adopted in traditional simulations—such as isotropic or 
approximate models—and enables end-to-end simulation from light propagation to 
image-level output. Imaging performance under various water types and depths was 
simulated for both natural and polarized light, and the impact of water on polarization 

Research on the Polarization Detection of Targets in  Complex Water Environments 
IV 
information transmission was quantitatively assessed using three image quality 
evaluation metrics. The results demonstrate that polarized light exhibits superior 
imaging performance in scattering media, thereby establishing a solid physical 
foundation for the development and enhancement of underwater polarization-based 
image restoration algorithms. 
This research on underwater polarization image restoration algorithms was 
initiated by introducing a physical degradation model of light propagation, which 
served as the theoretical foundation for subsequent algorithm development. A detailed 
analysis of the principles and limitations of traditional underwater polarization methods 
was performed. Based on Monte Carlo-simulated underwater scattering images, the 
polarization angle matrix was extracted and analyzed, revealing a distinct regional 
distribution pattern within the images that enables effective differentiation between 
target and background areas. Leveraging this characteristic, an adaptive image 
restoration algorithm driven by the distribution of polarization angles was proposed, 
which significantly improves upon the limitations of conventional methods in terms of 
real-time performance and restoration quality. The proposed algorithm requires no 
preset parameters and exhibits strong adaptability, as demonstrated in both simulations 
and experimental validations. Quantitative evaluations show that the algorithm offers 
substantial advantages in enhancing image details and structural similarity, indicating 
its significant potential for improving underwater imaging quality and enabling real-
time target detection. 
A full-polarization underwater imaging lens with synchronous acquisition 
capability was proposed and developed. By introducing a sub-aperture imaging 
structure into the underwater polarization imaging system, the design enables single-
frame acquisition of complete Stokes parameters, effectively alleviating the limitations 
of traditional multi-frame approaches in balancing real-time performance, structural 
complexity, and system integration. The system structure and key parameters were 
optimized based on the differences in light propagation characteristics between 
underwater and terrestrial imaging environments. The finalized optical system achieves 
MTF values above 0.75 at the Nyquist frequency (46 lp/mm), encircled energy over 80% 
within a 5.5 μm radius, and 90% relative illumination at the edge of the field of view. 
While ensuring imaging quality, the lens supports efficient and synchronous acquisition 
of polarization information, providing a deployable optical platform for real-time 
underwater imaging and algorithm integration. It shows strong potential for 
applications requiring a wide field of view, compact form factor, and lightweight design. 
 
Key Words: Underwater Detection, Polarization Imaging, Adaptive Algorithm, Image 
Restoration, Optical Design

I 
 
摘  要 
摄像是人类获取外部信息的主要手段之一。高质量的图像富含大量的有用信
息，不仅能够辅助人们做出相应的决策和判断，而且可以促进计算机视觉任务需求
的提升。然而受云、雾和水体等散射介质的干扰，使成像设备采集的图像发生不同
程度的退化，丢失大量有用信息，难以被决策者和计算机视觉领域充分利用。因
此，通过图像复原技术获取高质量的清晰图像，已经成为机器视觉领域亟需解决的
突出问题。近年来，深度学习驱动下的视觉任务处理能力显著提升，尤其在图像识
别、分割精度与目标跟踪等领域取得重要突破。在图像复原任务中，深度学习技术
也发挥了重要作用。主要体现在特征提取与学习、端到端复原、生成对抗网络、
Transformer 架构、多任务学习与泛化能力的提升等方面。 
因此，本文基于深度学习相关理论，针对受薄云、雾和水体三类散射介质的干
扰而获取的退化图像复原问题展开研究，具体研究内容如下： 
(1) 针对现有去雾技术在复原自然场景有雾图像时存在色彩失真、去雾过度等问
题，提出基于多尺度注意力特征增强的图像去雾技术。该技术通过有效结合注意力
机制、上下文增强模块和高效空间金字塔模块，分别构建了注意力特征增强模块和
多尺度特征增强模块。注意力特征增强模块用以解决注意力机制提取特征过程中丢
失细节信息的问题，其不但能够通过注意力机制自适应的提取重要通道特征和与雾
和高频信息相关的像素特征，并且能够有效捕捉上下文信息，抑制冗余信息。多尺
度特征增强模块是对注意力特征增强模块的进一步补充，其结合了高效空间金字塔
模块和注意力特征增强模块，该模块具备注意力特征增强模块的全部优势，同时能
够获取不同尺度的特征信息，从而增强网络的表达能力。实验结果表明，复原出的
自然场景有雾图像取得了较好的去雾效果，颜色信息保留完整，优于现有的先进去
雾技术。 
(2) 针对现有去雾技术在复原遥感场景有雾图像时存在细节信息丢失严重等问题 
，提出基于细节增强的遥感图像去雾技术。该技术是一个改进的5 阶段U-Net 型网络
结构，利用提出的细节增强块替换U-Net 中的卷积块。细节增强块主要包含多尺度细
节增强单元和阶梯式注意力细节增强单元，用以获取遥感图像的多尺度特征，关注
全局共享信息及与位置相关的局部信息，增强细节信息。同时在该技术中嵌入了SK 
Fusion、并行归一化模块和软重构，以分别用来融合深浅层特征、增强网络拟合能
力，调整并重建清晰遥感图像。实验结果表明，该技术能够有效的保留图像细节信
息，具有较好的鲁棒性。 
(3) 针对现有去云雾技术在复原遥感场景中有雾或薄云图像时存在云雾去除不彻
底、纹理信息缺失严重等问题，提出基于逆认知学习的遥感图像去云雾技术。该技

 
Ⅱ 
术中的多尺度逆认知学习块是整个网络的核心组件，其能够有效的提取图像的多尺
度信息，对不均匀分布的云雾特征进行自适应约束，它与SK Fusion 和软重建技术等
组件的共同作用，复原出了高质量的遥感图像。其中，在多尺度逆认知学习块中为
反向模拟人脑从整体到局部认知图像过程，设计了逆认知学习模块以逐步的实现从
局部到全局的特征学习。为有效对云雾特征进行约束，设计了并行云雾约束模块，
实现了对云雾信息强有力的约束。实验结果表明，该技术具有很好的去云雾能力，
纹理等细节信息保留较好，复原的遥感图像更接近现实世界视觉效果。 
(4) 针对水下图像存在颜色失真和模糊等问题，提出基于门控融合Transformer 的
水下图像复原技术。该技术是以门控融合Transformer 块为核心的U-Net 型网络，用
以获取水下图像的全局信息，增强细节信息。在门控融合Transformer 块中，通过引
入的通道像素自注意力和移位窗口像素自注意力实现通道特征和像素特征的双重关
注，利用提出的注意力前馈网络，整合并增强细节信息，实现不同层间的细节互
补。为避免局部细节信息的丢失，提出门控融合连接器替换常用的跳跃连接，进一
步提升网络恢复图像细节的能力。此外，将提出的深层环境适配器嵌入门控融合
Transformer 块中，以灵活的对输入特征重要信息进行关注，提升网络的表征能力。
实验结果表明，该技术有效的复原了退化水下图像，恢复了水下图像的颜色信息，
增强了水下图像的局部细节，明显提升了图像质量。 
 
关键词：深度学习；散射介质；退化图像；图像去云雾；水下图像复原 

 
I 
 
ABSTRACT 
Photography is one of the main means for human beings to obtain external information. 
High-quality images are rich in useful information, which can not only assist people to make 
appropriate decisions and judgments, but also promote the improvement of computer vision 
task requirements. However, due to the interference of cloud, fog, water and other scattering 
media, the images captured by imaging devices are degraded to varying degrees, and a large 
number of useful information is lost, which is difficult to be fully utilized by decision makers 
and computer vision fields. Therefore, it has become an urgent problem to be solved in the 
field of machine vision to obtain high quality and clear images through image restoration 
technology. In recent years, the ability of visual task processing driven by deep learning has 
been significantly improved, especially in the fields of image recognition, segmentation 
accuracy and target tracking. Deep learning technology also plays an important role in image 
restoration tasks. It is mainly reflected in feature extraction and learning, end-to-end 
restoration, generation of antagonistic networks, Transformer architecture, multi-task 
learning and generalization capabilities. 
Therefore, based on the theory of deep learning, this paper studies the restoration of 
degraded images obtained by the interference of three kinds of scattering media, namely, thin 
clouds, fog and water. 
(1) Aiming at the problems of color distortion and over-defogging in the restoration of 
foggy images in natural scenes by existing defogging technologies, an image defogging 
technology based on multi-scale attention feature enhancement is proposed. By effectively 
combining the attention mechanism, the context enhancement module and the efficient 
spatial pyramid module, the attention feature enhancement module and the multi-scale 
feature enhancement module are constructed respectively. The attention feature enhancement 
module is used for solving the problem that detail information is lost in the feature extraction 
process of the attention mechanism, and can not only adaptively extract important channel 
features and pixel features related to fog and high-frequency information through the 
attention mechanism, but also effectively capture context information and inhibit redundant 
information. The multi-scale feature enhancement module is a further supplement to the 
attention feature enhancement module, which combines the efficient spatial pyramid module 
and the attention feature enhancement module. The module has all the advantages of the 
attention feature enhancement module, and can obtain feature information of different scales, 
thereby enhancing the expressive power of the network. The experimental results show that 
the restored natural scene images with fog achieve good defogging effect, and color 
information is kept intact, which is better than existing advanced defogging technology. 
(2) The existing defogging technology has the problem of serious loss of detail 
information when restoring the foggy image of the remote sensing scene. 

 
II 
 
In this paper, a remote sensing image defogging technique based on detail enhancement is 
proposed. This technique is an improved 5-stage U-Net type network structure, which uses 
the proposed detail enhancement block to replace the convolution block in U-Net. The detail 
enhancement block mainly comprises a multi-scale detail enhancement unit and a stepped 
attention detail enhancement unit, and is used for acquiring multi-scale characteristics of a 
remote sensing image, paying attention to global shared information and location-related 
local information, and enhancing detail information. At the same time, SK Fusion and parallel 
normalization module are embedded in this technology to fuse deep and shallow features and 
enhance the fitting ability of the network, respectively. The soft reconstruction technology is 
used to adjust and reconstruct clear remote sensing images. The experimental results show 
that the technique can effectively preserve the image details and has good robustness. 
(3) In order to solve the problems of incomplete cloud and fog removal and serious lack 
of texture information when the existing cloud and fog removal technology is used to restore 
the remote sensing scene with fog or thin cloud, a remote sensing image cloud and fog 
removal technology based on inverse cognitive learning is proposed. The multi-scale inverse 
cognitive learning block in the technology is the core component of the whole network, which 
can effectively extract the multi-scale information of the image and carry out adaptive 
constraint on the cloud and mist characteristics of uneven distribution. With the joint action 
of SK Fusion and soft reconstruction technology, the high-quality remote sensing image is 
restored. In that multi-scale inverse cognitive learn block, an inverse cognitive learning 
module is design to realize feature learning from the whole to the whole step by step in order 
to reversely simulate the image cognitive process of the human brain from the whole to the 
part. In order to effectively constrain the cloud and fog characteristics, a parallel cloud and 
fog constraint module is designed to achieve a strong constraint on cloud and fog information. 
The experimental results show that the technology has a good ability to remove cloud and 
fog, texture and other details are better preserved and the restored remote sensing image is 
closer to the visual effect of the real world. 
(4) Aiming at the problems of color distortion and blur in underwater images, an 
underwater image restoration technology based on gated fusion Transformer is proposed. The 
technology is a U-shaped network with a gated fusion Transformer block as the core, which 
is used to obtain the global information of underwater images, and enhance detail 
information. In the gated fused Transform er block, the channel pixel self-attention and the 
shift window pixel self-attention are introduced to realize the dual attention of channel 
features and pixel features, and the proposed attention feed-forward network is used to 
integrate and enhance the detail information, so as to realize the detail complementarity 
between different layers. In order to avoid the loss of local detail information, a gated fusion 
connector is proposed to replace the commonly used skip connection, which further improves 
the ability of the network to recover detail information. In addition, the proposed deep 

 
III 
 
environment adapter is embedded into the gated fusion Transformer block to flexibly focus 
on the important information of the input features and improve the representation ability of 
the network. The experimental results show that the technology can effectively restore the 
degraded underwater image, restore the color information of the underwater image, enhance 
the local details of the underwater image, and significantly improve the image quality. 
 
Key words: deep learning; scattering media; degraded image; image cloud removal; 
underwater image restoration

程度的退化，丢失大量有用信息，难以被决策者和计算机视觉领域充分利用。因
此，通过图像复原技术获取高质量的清晰图像，已经成为机器视觉领域亟需解决的
突出问题。近年来，深度学习驱动下的视觉任务处理能力显著提升，尤其在图像识
别、分割精度与目标跟踪等领域取得重要突破。在图像复原任务中，深度学习技术
也发挥了重要作用。主要体现在特征提取与学习、端到端复原、生成对抗网络、
Transformer 架构、多任务学习与泛化能力的提升等方面。 
因此，本文基于深度学习相关理论，针对受薄云、雾和水体三类散射介质的干
扰而获取的退化图像复原问题展开研究，具体研究内容如下： 
(1) 针对现有去雾技术在复原自然场景有雾图像时存在色彩失真、去雾过度等问
题，提出基于多尺度注意力特征增强的图像去雾技术。该技术通过有效结合注意力
机制、上下文增强模块和高效空间金字塔模块，分别构建了注意力特征增强模块和
多尺度特征增强模块。注意力特征增强模块用以解决注意力机制提取特征过程中丢
失细节信息的问题，其不但能够通过注意力机制自适应的提取重要通道特征和与雾
和高频信息相关的像素特征，并且能够有效捕捉上下文信息，抑制冗余信息。多尺
度特征增强模块是对注意力特征增强模块的进一步补充，其结合了高效空间金字塔
模块和注意力特征增强模块，该模块具备注意力特征增强模块的全部优势，同时能
够获取不同尺度的特征信息，从而增强网络的表达能力。实验结果表明，复原出的
自然场景有雾图像取得了较好的去雾效果，颜色信息保留完整，优于现有的先进去
雾技术。 
(2) 针对现有去雾技术在复原遥感场景有雾图像时存在细节信息丢失严重等问题 
，提出基于细节增强的遥感图像去雾技术。该技术是一个改进的5 阶段U-Net 型网络
结构，利用提出的细节增强块替换U-Net 中的卷积块。细节增强块主要包含多尺度细
节增强单元和阶梯式注意力细节增强单元，用以获取遥感图像的多尺度特征，关注
全局共享信息及与位置相关的局部信息，增强细节信息。同时在该技术中嵌入了SK 
Fusion、并行归一化模块和软重构，以分别用来融合深浅层特征、增强网络拟合能
力，调整并重建清晰遥感图像。实验结果表明，该技术能够有效的保留图像细节信
息，具有较好的鲁棒性。 
(3) 针对现有去云雾技术在复原遥感场景中有雾或薄云图像时存在云雾去除不彻
底、纹理信息缺失严重等问题，提出基于逆认知学习的遥感图像去云雾技术。该技

 
Ⅱ 
术中的多尺度逆认知学习块是整个网络的核心组件，其能够有效的提取图像的多尺
度信息，对不均匀分布的云雾特征进行自适应约束，它与SK Fusion 和软重建技术等
组件的共同作用，复原出了高质量的遥感图像。其中，在多尺度逆认知学习块中为
反向模拟人脑从整体到局部认知图像过程，设计了逆认知学习模块以逐步的实现从
局部到全局的特征学习。为有效对云雾特征进行约束，设计了并行云雾约束模块，
实现了对云雾信息强有力的约束。实验结果表明，该技术具有很好的去云雾能力，
纹理等细节信息保留较好，复原的遥感图像更接近现实世界视觉效果。 
(4) 针对水下图像存在颜色失真和模糊等问题，提出基于门控融合Transformer 的
水下图像复原技术。该技术是以门控融合Transformer 块为核心的U-Net 型网络，用
以获取水下图像的全局信息，增强细节信息。在门控融合Transformer 块中，通过引
入的通道像素自注意力和移位窗口像素自注意力实现通道特征和像素特征的双重关
注，利用提出的注意力前馈网络，整合并增强细节信息，实现不同层间的细节互
补。为避免局部细节信息的丢失，提出门控融合连接器替换常用的跳跃连接，进一
步提升网络恢复图像细节的能力。此外，将提出的深层环境适配器嵌入门控融合
Transformer 块中，以灵活的对输入特征重要信息进行关注，提升网络的表征能力。
实验结果表明，该技术有效的复原了退化水下图像，恢复了水下图像的颜色信息，
增强了水下图像的局部细节，明显提升了图像质量。 
 
关键词：深度学习；散射介质；退化图像；图像去云雾；水下图像复原 

 
I 
 
ABSTRACT 
Photography is one of the main means for human beings to obtain external information. 
High-quality images are rich in useful information, which can not only assist people to make 
appropriate decisions and judgments, but also promote the improvement of computer vision 
task requirements. However, due to the interference of cloud, fog, water and other scattering 
media, the images captured by imaging devices are degraded to varying degrees, and a large 
number of useful information is lost, which is difficult to be fully utilized by decision makers 
and computer vision fields. Therefore, it has become an urgent problem to be solved in the 
field of machine vision to obtain high quality and clear images through image restoration 
technology. In recent years, the ability of visual task processing driven by deep learning has 
been significantly improved, especially in the fields of image recognition, segmentation 
accuracy and target tracking. Deep learning technology also plays an important role in image 
restoration tasks. It is mainly reflected in feature extraction and learning, end-to-end 
restoration, generation of antagonistic networks, Transformer architecture, multi-task 
learning and generalization capabilities. 
Therefore, based on the theory of deep learning, this paper studies the restoration of 
degraded images obtained by the interference of three kinds of scattering media, namely, thin 
clouds, fog and water. 
(1) Aiming at the problems of color distortion and over-defogging in the restoration of 
foggy images in natural scenes by existing defogging technologies, an image defogging 
technology based on multi-scale attention feature enhancement is proposed. By effectively 
combining the attention mechanism, the context enhancement module and the efficient 
spatial pyramid module, the attention feature enhancement module and the multi-scale 
feature enhancement module are constructed respectively. The attention feature enhancement 
module is used for solving the problem that detail information is lost in the feature extraction 
process of the attention mechanism, and can not only adaptively extract important channel 
features and pixel features related to fog and high-frequency information through the 
attention mechanism, but also effectively capture context information and inhibit redundant 
information. The multi-scale feature enhancement module is a further supplement to the 
attention feature enhancement module, which combines the efficient spatial pyramid module 
and the attention feature enhancement module. The module has all the advantages of the 
attention feature enhancement module, and can obtain feature information of different scales, 
thereby enhancing the expressive power of the network. The experimental results show that 
the restored natural scene images with fog achieve good defogging effect, and color 
information is kept intact, which is better than existing advanced defogging technology. 
(2) The existing defogging technology has the problem of serious loss of detail 
information when restoring the foggy image of the remote sensing scene. 

 
II 
 
In this paper, a remote sensing image defogging technique based on detail enhancement is 
proposed. This technique is an improved 5-stage U-Net type network structure, which uses 
the proposed detail enhancement block to replace the convolution block in U-Net. The detail 
enhancement block mainly comprises a multi-scale detail enhancement unit and a stepped 
attention detail enhancement unit, and is used for acquiring multi-scale characteristics of a 
remote sensing image, paying attention to global shared information and location-related 
local information, and enhancing detail information. At the same time, SK Fusion and parallel 
normalization module are embedded in this technology to fuse deep and shallow features and 
enhance the fitting ability of the network, respectively. The soft reconstruction technology is 
used to adjust and reconstruct clear remote sensing images. The experimental results show 
that the technique can effectively preserve the image details and has good robustness. 
(3) In order to solve the problems of incomplete cloud and fog removal and serious lack 
of texture information when the existing cloud and fog removal technology is used to restore 
the remote sensing scene with fog or thin cloud, a remote sensing image cloud and fog 
removal technology based on inverse cognitive learning is proposed. The multi-scale inverse 
cognitive learning block in the technology is the core component of the whole network, which 
can effectively extract the multi-scale information of the image and carry out adaptive 
constraint on the cloud and mist characteristics of uneven distribution. With the joint action 
of SK Fusion and soft reconstruction technology, the high-quality remote sensing image is 
restored. In that multi-scale inverse cognitive learn block, an inverse cognitive learning 
module is design to realize feature learning from the whole to the whole step by step in order 
to reversely simulate the image cognitive process of the human brain from the whole to the 
part. In order to effectively constrain the cloud and fog characteristics, a parallel cloud and 
fog constraint module is designed to achieve a strong constraint on cloud and fog information. 
The experimental results show that the technology has a good ability to remove cloud and 
fog, texture and other details are better preserved and the restored remote sensing image is 
closer to the visual effect of the real world. 
(4) Aiming at the problems of color distortion and blur in underwater images, an 
underwater image restoration technology based on gated fusion Transformer is proposed. The 
technology is a U-shaped network with a gated fusion Transformer block as the core, which 
is used to obtain the global information of underwater images, and enhance detail 
information. In the gated fused Transform er block, the channel pixel self-attention and the 
shift window pixel self-attention are introduced to realize the dual attention of channel 
features and pixel features, and the proposed attention feed-forward network is used to 
integrate and enhance the detail information, so as to realize the detail complementarity 
between different layers. In order to avoid the loss of local detail information, a gated fusion 
connector is proposed to replace the commonly used skip connection, which further improves 
the ability of the network to recover detail information. In addition, the proposed deep 

 
III 
 
environment adapter is embedded into the gated fusion Transformer block to flexibly focus 
on the important information of the input features and improve the representation ability of 
the network. The experimental results show that the technology can effectively restore the 
degraded underwater image, restore the color information of the underwater image, enhance 
the local details of the underwater image, and significantly improve the image quality. 
 
Key words: deep learning; scattering media; degraded image; image cloud removal; 
underwater image restoration

摘要
摘
要
随着计算机视觉的快速发展，目标识别技术（分类、检测、分割等）已广泛应用
于自动驾驶、智能监控、医疗影像分析和工业检测等领域。深度学习模型通常依赖大
规模高质量图像，以提取丰富的特征信息。然而，在真实场景中图像质量易受多种因
素影响，包括成像系统的低分辨率与热噪声、环境光变化与恶劣天气、以及运动目标
导致的模糊与失焦等。这些低质量图像极大增加了特征提取的难度。特征信息缺乏可
能引起识别目标混淆，导致模型以高置信度误识别。而在许多实际应用中，算法需在
低质量图像条件下依然保持高识别精度，以确保系统的稳定性与可靠性。因此，提升
目标识别算法在低质量图像上的鲁棒性具有重要的现实意义。
目前，已有多种方法致力于提升低质量图像下的目标识别鲁棒性，主要包括图像
预处理、特征增强和数据增广等策略。图像预处理通过去噪、超分辨率、去模糊、去
雨雾和暗光增强等技术改善图像质量，常与识别网络联合训练以提升性能，但其效果
受限于退化类型的多样性，且双阶段处理计算开销较大。特征增强方法利用清晰-退
化图像对重建深层语义特征，提升特征表达能力，尽管高效，但简单的重建损失难以
区分各区域对识别的重要性。数据增广和域泛化则通过特定训练策略提升模型对未
知退化的适应性，具备较强泛化能力，然而其复杂的模型结构和精心设计的增广策
略降低了算法的实用性，同时由于缺乏对数据分布的建模，可能引入大量无效样本，
训练成本增加但性能提升有限。
综上，现有鲁棒性识别技术虽提升了低质量图像的可用性，但仍面临计算复杂度
高、判别性特征提取不足、依赖成对数据，及依赖特定退化假设等问题，整体性能仍
存在瓶颈。为此，本文以数据为驱动，分别探究退化数据的不确定性、数据的本征表
示和难样本数据的分布，围绕低质量图像的鲁棒性识别展开研究，提出三种创新算
法，在数据依赖上逐步优化：从依赖成对图像数据，到混合非成对输入，最终摆脱仿
真退化图像的依赖，显著提升了识别的鲁棒性与实用性。本文的主要研究内容与创新
点如下：
1. 针对现有的基于特征增强的低质量图像鲁棒识别方法通常采用教师-学生网络
结构，并使用L2 - 范数作为蒸馏约束，未能考虑到低质图像数据分布的不确定性以
及特征中不同区域的重要性等问题，本文提出了一种基于特征不确定性建模的自蒸
馏方法。具体地，本方法首先提出仅使用一个模型的自特征蒸馏框架，将成对的清
晰-仿真退化图像数据同时输入到该网络中进行特征提取。其次，对退化特征引入了
数据不确定性建模机制，旨在更精确地识别图像数据中的困难区域，自适应地调整蒸
馏损失。针对难以恢复的特征区域增加蒸馏损失的权重，改善特征重建的质量。大量
I

实验结果表明，与现有的国内外先进方法相比，所提出的方法能够更有效地重建低质
量图像中的重点判别性区域特征，显著提升了鲁棒识别性能。
2. 针对现有的低质量图像鲁棒性识别方法依赖成对的清晰-退化图像数据进行训
练，算法适用性、可移植性较弱等问题，受稀疏表示学习和矢量量化算法的启发，本
文围绕数据的本征表示展开研究，提出基于向量量化的图像质量无关特征表示学习
方法。该方法首先在网络中添加一个码本（字典）模块来量化模型提取的的深层语义
特征。量化过程实现了对特征数据中本质信息的建模，去除了冗余的噪声干扰。定性
和定量实验结果均表明，所提出的方法实现了在无需成对图像数据的训练模式下，能
够提取数据中的质量无关的表示，相较于其他国内外方法在多个鲁棒性基准测试集
上准确性更优，且适用性更强。
3. 针对基于特征重建等方法依赖仿真退化数据，以及数据增广和域泛化方法缺
乏对模型如何受分布变化影响的深入认知等问题，基于易混淆难样本数据分布，本文
提出生成近邻类梯度扰动困难样本数据的对抗训练方法。具体地，使用与样本真实标
签相邻的易混淆类别的梯度来扰动输入图像，生成对抗数据样本进行训练，并结合类
间距离加权损失函数来增大类间分散性。该方法鼓励模型从易出错的数据中学习更
具弹性的特征，增强其对不同数据分布变化的鲁棒性。在各种模型架构和基准数据集
的广泛实验中，本方法相较于国内外先进方法拥有更优越的性能，更少的迭代训练次
数，且无需引入额外的训练参数。
关键词：深度学习，图像分类，目标检测，退化图像，神经网络鲁棒性，不确定性，
矢量量化，对抗训练

ABSTRACT
ABSTRACT
With the rapid development of computer vision, object recognition technologies—including
classification, detection, and segmentation—have been widely applied in fields such as au-
tonomous driving, intelligent surveillance, medical image analysis, and industrial inspection.
Deep learning models typically rely on large-scale, high-quality images to extract rich feature
representations. However, in real-world scenarios, image quality is often degraded by var-
ious factors, including low resolution and thermal noise from imaging systems, changes in
ambient lighting and adverse weather conditions, as well as motion-induced blur and defocus.
These low-quality images substantially increase the diﬀiculty of feature extraction. The lack
of informative features can lead to target confusion and high-confidence misrecognition. In
many practical applications, recognition algorithms are required to maintain high accuracy
even under low-quality image conditions to ensure the stability and reliability of the overall
system. Therefore, improving the robustness of object recognition algorithms for low-quality
images is of significant practical importance.
Recently, various methods have been proposed to enhance the robustness of object recogni-
tion under low-quality image conditions, mainly including image preprocessing, feature en-
hancement, and data augmentation strategies. Image preprocessing improves image quality
through techniques such as denoising, super-resolution, deblurring, deraining, and low-light
enhancement, and is often jointly trained with recognition networks to improve performance.
However, its effectiveness is limited by the diversity of degradation types, and the two-stage
processing introduces significant computational overhead. Feature enhancement methods re-
construct deep semantic features using paired clean and degraded images to improve feature
representation. Although eﬀicient, simple reconstruction losses struggle to distinguish the
importance of different regions for recognition. Data augmentation and domain generaliza-
tion improve the model’s adaptability to unknown degradations through specific training
strategies and offer strong generalization ability. However, their complex model architectures
and carefully designed augmentation strategies reduce practical usability. In addition, due to
the lack of modeling of data distributions, they may introduce a large number of ineffective
samples, increasing training cost with limited performance improvement.
In summary, although existing robust recognition techniques have improved the usability of

low-quality images, they still face several challenges, including high computational com-
plexity, insuﬀicient extraction of discriminative features, dependence on paired data,
and reliance on specific degradation assumptions, which hinder further performance im-
provements. To address these issues, this work adopts a data-driven approach, focusing on
the uncertainty of degraded data, the intrinsic representation of data, and the distribu-
tion of hard samples. This work investigates robust recognition under low-quality image
conditions and proposes three novel algorithms that progressively reduce data dependency:
from relying on paired image data, to using mixed unpaired inputs, and ultimately re-
moving the reliance on synthetically degraded images, thereby significantly improving
both the robustness and practicality of recognition. The main research contributions and
innovations of this work are as follows:
1. To address the limitations of existing feature enhancement-based robust recognition meth-
ods, which typically adopt a teacher-student architecture and employ L2-norm as the distilla-
tion constraint—without considering the uncertainty in the data distribution of low-quality
images and the varying importance of different feature regions—this work proposes a self-
distillation method based on feature uncertainty modeling. Specifically, a self-feature distil-
lation framework using only a single model is proposed, in which paired clean and syntheti-
cally degraded images are simultaneously fed into the network for feature extraction. A data
uncertainty modeling mechanism is introduced into the degraded features to more accurately
identify diﬀicult regions in the image and adaptively reweight the distillation loss. The distil-
lation loss is emphasized in regions where features are hard to recover, improving the quality
of feature reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that, compared with existing state-
of-the-art methods, the proposed method more effectively reconstructs key discriminative
regions in low-quality images and significantly enhances robust recognition performance.
2.To address the limitations of current robust recognition methods for low-quality images
that rely on paired clean-degraded image data—leading to limited algorithm applicability
and transferability—this work investigates the intrinsic representation of data and pro-
poses a vector quantization-based quality-invariant feature learning method. Inspired by
sparse representation learning and vector quantization techniques, the proposed method in-
troduces a codebook (dictionary) module into the network to quantize the deep semantic
features extracted by the model. This quantization process models the essential information
in the feature data and eliminates redundant noise. Both qualitative and quantitative results

without requiring paired images for training, and achieves better accuracy across multiple
robustness benchmarks compared to other state-of-the-art approaches, while also providing
